caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal cup with a handle on the right side, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on a beige background. The cup has a slightly wider rim at the top and horizontal bands around its body, with some texture and detailing to indicate reflections and surface variation. Inside the cup, there is a central cylindrical object that extends above the rim, possibly a smaller container or an inner structure. The handle curves outward and upward from the right side of the cup and then loops back down to attach to the body. The drawing is centered on the page, and at the lower left corner, the name "Julius Bellamy" is handwritten in small, neat letters. The background is plain and unadorned, with a uniform beige color throughout.
title: Wetting Cup
